dust.en: Ground to a fine powder, it is, says Mathilde, grey dust.
dust.zh: Mathilde 说，把它磨成细粉，就是灰色的尘土。”

dust.en: He arrived, sunburned, half-starved, and covered in dust, but triumphant.
dust.zh: 他到达时，皮肤被晒伤，半饥半饱，满身尘土，但凯旋而归。

dust.en: When the solar system was formed, heavy elements like gold, platinum, nickel, and iron were distributed throughout the massive cloud of gas and dust that eventually became the Sun and the planets.
dust.zh: 当太阳系形成时，金、铂、镍和铁等重元素分布在最终形成太阳和行星的庞大气体和尘土云中。

dust.en: Most probably, there would be some kind of great canopy, a tent-like structure, that was put over the area that was being mined, otherwise, all of the dust and precious metals would simply blow away into space.
dust.zh: 最有可能的情况是，会有某种巨大的天篷、类似于帐篷的结构，被搭建在正在开采的区域上方，否则，所有的尘埃和贵金属都会直接被吹进太空中。

dull.en: And secondly, I thought the content of the episodes themselves sounded dull.
dull.zh: 其次，我觉得节目内容本身听起来很枯燥。

dull.en: Mental clarity is a state in which your mind is fully focused and active, not dull or foggy.
dull.zh: Mental clarity 是一种你的大脑高度专注和活跃、而不是沉闷或模糊的状态。

dull.en: The phrase a splash of colour is used when a bit of colour is added to brighten something which is dull or unexciting.
dull.zh: 短语“一抹亮色”（a splash of colour）用于在沉闷或无趣的东西上增添一点色彩使其显得鲜亮。

dull.en: For example, an energy drink might claim to improve your gut health or your mental clarity – a term describing a state of mind which is focused and engaged, not dull or foggy.
dull.zh: 例如，功能饮料可能会宣称能改善你的肠道健康或 mental clarity——这个术语描述了一种专注、投入、而不沉闷或模糊的心智状态。

dull.en: She's the size of a six or seven-year-old child and decorated with a splash of colour – a phrase used when a bit of colour is added to brighten up something which is dull or unexciting.
dull.zh: 她有六七岁孩子那么高，身上点缀着一抹亮色（a splash of colour）——这个短语用于在单调乏味或毫无生趣的事物上增添一点色彩来使其变得明亮。

due.en: And what followed was not due legal process, it was revenge, pure and simple.
due.zh: 接下来发生的事，不是什么正当的法律程序，而是彻头彻尾的复仇。

due.en: Canada also has the Arctic, which could really change due to climate change.
due.zh: 加拿大还拥有北极地区，该地区可能会因气候变化而发生剧烈改变。

due.en: And third, the Renaissance is famous due to the individuals who were working during this period.
due.zh: 第三，文艺复兴之所以闻名，是因为这个时期涌现的杰出人物。

due.en: Yet unfortunately, due to economic or emotional reasons, many people stay trapped.
due.zh: 然而不幸的是，由于经济或情感原因，许多人仍然被困在其中。

due.en: Meat was cooked until it was extremely well done, partly due to misunderstandings about food safety.
due.zh: 肉被煮到熟透甚至变老，部分原因是对食品安全的误解。

durable.en: So, to wrap things up, the "mad king" remains one of history's most durable caricatures.
durable.zh: 总之，归纳一下，“疯王”依然是历史上最具持久力的漫画式形象之一。

duty.en: MBN was going to be removed from all duties, and MBS would replace him as Crown Prince.
duty.zh: MBN将被解除所有职务，MBS将取代他成为王储。

duty.en: Of course, people genuinely believed that the sacred mattered, and that they had a Christian duty to protect it.
duty.zh: 当然，人们确实相信神圣至关重要，他们有保护神圣的基督教责任。

duty.en: He has separate jobs. When King Charles III performs his duties in Britain, he is the King of the United Kingdom.
duty.zh: 他有着不同的职责。当查尔斯三世国王在英国履行职责时，他是英国国王。

duty.en: So, what does the Vice President actually do, other than assume the duties of the President if they die or are incapacitated?
duty.zh: 那么，副总统除了在总统死亡或丧失履职能力时承担总统职责之外，实际上还做些什么呢？

duty.en: But when he performs duties related to Canada, he is the King of Canada, and he follows the advice of the Canadian prime minister.
duty.zh: 但当他履行与加拿大相关的职责时，他是加拿大国王，并且他要遵循加拿大首相的建议。

duration.en: It was slightly more complicated than this, and activities were split up into seven factors: Intensity, Duration, Certainty, Proximity, Fecundity, Purity, and Extent.
duration.zh: 实际情况稍微复杂一点，活动被细分为七个因素：强度、持续时间、确定性、邻近性、多产性、纯粹性和范围。

duration.en: And for the duration of the campaign, he had never made any requests, not a single demand, nor had he officially claimed responsibility for any of the attacks.
duration.zh: 在整个袭击期间，他从未提出过任何要求，连一个诉求都没有，也没有官方宣称对任何袭击事件负责。

dumb.en: This means not artificially dumbing down my language or using simple terms, but I might say something twice in two different ways — first naturally, and then in another, simpler way that will help you understand if you didn’t the first time.
dumb.zh: 这意味着我不会刻意降低语言难度或使用简单的词汇，但我可能会用两种不同的方式把一件事说两遍——先用自然的表达，然后再用另一种更简单的方式，如果你第一次没听懂，这能帮你理解。

duplicate.en: There are around 100 of these advanced words and phrases per episode, so that’s more than 50,000 different definitions created, and when you remove the duplicates, the ones that have appeared twice or more, there’s something like 20,000 B2 and above words that you’d learn if you listened to every episode.
duplicate.zh: 每期节目大约有 100 个这类高级词汇和短语，所以我们已经创建了超过 50,000 条定义，如果去掉重复出现的词，如果你听完每一期节目，大约能学到 20,000 个 B2 及以上水平的单词。

duke.en: He betrayed Milan’s rulers, used his mercenary army to seize control of the city, and declared himself Duke of Milan.
duke.zh: 他背叛了米兰的统治者，利用他的雇佣兵军队夺取了该城的控制权，并宣布自己为米兰公爵。

dump.en: A group of colonists boarded a British ship in Boston Harbor and dumped hundreds of chests of tea into the water.
dump.zh: 一群殖民地居民登上波士顿港的一艘英国船只，把数百箱茶倒进了水里。

duck.en: For instance, a president in the final months of their term might be called a lame duck because Congress and the public pay less attention to their decisions.
duck.zh: 例如，处于任期最后几个月的总统可能会被称为跛脚鸭，因为国会和公众对他们的决策关注度会下降。

duck.en: A lame duck is not a bird that can’t fly, but a lame duck is an elected official whose power is weakened because they will soon leave office.
duck.zh: “跛脚鸭”（lame duck）可不是指不会飞的鸟，而是一位权力被削弱的民选官员，因为他们即将离任。
